data.name: Walking With The Wild
data.detailed_description:
Walking With The Wild is a 3D open‑world adventure‑thriller where you are cast into a mystical, untamed land with nothing but your mind and body. To survive, you must rely on your five enhanced senses — sight, sound, smell, touch, and intuition — each revealing hidden information about the world around you.

Explore dense forests, ancient ruins, and shifting biomes filled with wonder and danger. Creatures roam the land with their own behaviors, territories, and rivalries. Some stalk you. Some flee. Some can be lured into fighting each other — if you understand how to read the environment.

You are not a warrior. You are not armed. Survival depends on awareness, stealth, and your ability to interpret the world’s signals before it’s too late.

Will you find your way home, or will the wild consume you?

data.short_description: Nature so serene… yet so violent. In this adventure-thriller, you are cast into a mystical world with nothing but your mind and body. To survive, you must leverage your five powerful senses and overcome the horrors that surround you. Can you make it home, or will the journey be too draining?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5‑8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD RX 560 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Designed to run on mid‑range hardware.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7‑9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060 or AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for streaming open‑world assets.
